Name: Macau day trip
Location: Senado Square, Macau, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Ferry (TurboJET to Outer Harbour, Cotai Water Jet to Taipa) from Sheung Wan about 50-55 min, or HZMB bus; fares about HK$175-200 by ferry. Why: Portuguese-Chinese old town, egg tarts, Senado Square, casinos.

Name: Shenzhen day trip
Location: Futian, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Cross at Lo Wu/Luohu or Futian by MTR East Rail then immigration. Why: Mainland markets and food.

Name: Yim Tin Tsai
Location: Yim Tin Tsai, Sai Kung, New Territories, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Island with salt fields and St Joseph's Chapel reached by kaito from Sai Kung pier. Why: Hakka and Catholic heritage.

Name: Lai Chi Wo
Location: Lai Chi Wo, Tai Po, New Territories, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Hakka walled village in the Geopark, reached by Sunday/holiday ferry from Ma Liu Shui. Why: Well-preserved village and mangroves.

Name: Cheung Chau
Location: Cheung Chau Ferry Pier, Cheung Chau, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Car-free island by ferry from Central Pier 5. Why: Seafood and beaches.

Name: Lamma Island
Location: Yung Shue Wan, Lamma Island, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Island hike from Yung Shue Wan to Sok Kwu Wan with seafood. Why: Easy hike.

Name: Peng Chau
Location: Peng Chau; ferry from Central Pier 6, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China
Description: Small car-free island, walkable in about an hour, with a temple by the water (Lung Mo) and the Leather Factory art space on Wing On Street. Why: Slow village Hong Kong 30-35 min by fast ferry from Central.
